CompletedQuestDescription.SourceString: Challenging a garou king could have gone much worse, but you were able to obtain a piece of the garou homeworld for Vannaka to study. In return he revealed his deepest, darkest secret - he gets quite fluffy once a month. Maybe you should invest in a line of squeaky slayer-monster toys?

QuestDescription.SourceString: Investigate the Garou and their rituals.

Description.SourceString: Search Garou camps beneath giant wyrm bones in the Highlands for information on Garou ritual practices.

Description.SourceString: Challenge a Garou king in their Highland stronghold and claim their token.
Description.LocalizedString: Challenge a Garou king in their Highland stronghold and claim their token.

Description.SourceString: Search garou camps beneath the giant wyrm bones in the Highlands for information on the King's Token.

Description.SourceString: Complete the ritual of purification on the King's Token at the ancient shrine where "a heart once beat".

Description.SourceString: Bring the Purified King's Token to Vannaka in the Ghornfell Highlands.

Description.SourceString: Search the Ghornfell Highlands for a friendly face with an interest in Garou rituals.
